newsitem.title: USA: TWA will implement fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: TWA will implement fuel surcharge.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said on Thursday it plans to implement a $0.025 a pound fuel surcharge on all freight and Priority Air Express shipments effective February 1.
The decision reverses a previous decision by the airline made in November.

"Fuel prices have stabilized somewhat, but at a level significantly higher than a year ago and considerably higher than forecast by the airlines," TWA vice staff vice president for cargo sales Bob Uttmark said in a news release.
The airline said it does not plan to implement the charge on its Next Flight Out small package service.
